sloka: ततः प्रासाद हर्म्याणि विमान शिखराणि च ।अधिरुह्य जनः श्रीमान् उदासीनो व्यलोकयत् ॥२-३३-३॥
transliteration: tataḥ prāsāda harmyāṇi vimāna śikharāṇi ca ।adhiruhya janaḥ śrīmān udāsīno vyalokayat ॥2-33-3॥

translations.english: The rich climbed their palaces and mansions, terraces of sevenstoried buildings and watched them sadly.
